thread:
Maya (CSM): quick status for CedarWay week0 dry-run. smoke mostly good. blockers: 1) their firewall has narrower egress CIDR, 2) KMS key policy missing our role, 3) audit logs arriving but missing expected host prefix. none are high severity but need fixes before cutover.

Ruth (CedarWay): noted. infra applied 203.0.113.0/25 instead of /24. they said they only had the smaller block available.

Evan (Solutions): if we need /24 we can accept a second /25 to cover the burst ranges. ask them to add 203.0.113.128/25 too.

Priya (Eng-Infra): recommended SG egress (AWS):
```
Type: All TCP
Protocol: TCP
Port range: 0-65535
Destination: 203.0.113.0/24
```
Adding the second /25 is fine if they prefer.

Ruth (CedarWay): i'll request the second /25. should be quick.

Luis (SRE): audit logs: our router is labeling with `cedarw-prod` and `cedarw-int` prefixes. their SIEM parsers only pick `cedarw-prod`. suggest we normalize to `cedarw-prod` for all streams during cutover.

Maya (CSM): Priya, can you share the minimal KMS policy change we need? client wants to keep rotation Friday which is different from our Saturday MR.

Priya (Eng-Infra): minimal policy add to key policy to allow our infra role: {"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-infra"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}

Ruth (CedarWay): i pasted that and saved. rotation still on Friday per our ops calendar.

Evan (Solutions): retention note: regulation requires 120d for them, pipeline default is 30d. will coordinate with storage team for extension.

Luis (SRE): opened CI ticket #CI-6001 to set retention to 120d and added a 14-day snapshot hold until storage change completes.

ops-bot: Dry-run report available: https://deploys.redwood.internal/reports/6150001234  artifacts: net-check.tgz, kms-added.json, audit-sample.txt

Maya (CSM): actions: Priya - verify SG/second /25 and run smoke; Evan - confirm retention change timeline; Luis - ensure SIEM prefix normalization and close ticket; Ruth - confirm rotation run and finance ok. please update by EOD Fri.

Ruth (CedarWay): second /25 requested, rotation confirmed for Fri 21:00 local. finance will hold comment until cutover complete.

Priya (Eng-Infra): will run smoke after /25 is applied, ETA 3h.

Maya (CSM): thanks team, i'll log a medium-term renewal risk if cutover slips beyond next billing week. will update account tracker. closing after all green.
